mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t1.coll_jusu AS collJusu , t1.collateral AS collateral , TO_CHAR(t1.coll_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS collStart , TO_CHAR(t1.coll_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS collEnd , jm.fund_cd AS jmFundCd , jm.jm_cd AS jmJmCd , jm.bfil_boyu_jusu AS bfilBoyuJusu , jm.up_jusu AS upJusu , jm.dw_jusu AS dwJusu , jm.koscom_cd AS koscom_cd , jm.balh_co AS balhCo , TO_CHAR(jm.coll_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS jmStart , TO_CHAR(jm.coll_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS jmEnd , jj.jj_nm AS jjNm , CASE WHEN jm.coll_end IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS pVisible , CASE WHEN t1.fund_cd IS NULL THEN 'new' ELSE 'jango' END AS collStatus FROM SJM0JM jm LEFT OUTER JOIN SJM0JM_COLL t1 ON t1.corp_gr = jm.corp_gr AND t1.fund_cd = jm.fund_cd AND t1.ymd = jm.ymd AND t1.jm_cd = jm.jm_cd , SJM0JJ jj WHERE jm.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND jm.fund_cd = #{fundCd} AND jm.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND jm.bs_type = 0 AND jj.jm_cd = jm.jm_cd ORDER BY pVisible DESC, jm.jm_cd ASC
SELECT t1.fund_cd AS "fundCd" , t1.fund_nm AS "fundNm" FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC
